title: Classic co-op camera (Camera Distance 2.9.12): centred on both players, from above
intro: Two controllers, both awake (press a button on each). A full party, open ground, playing the Arisen, co-op off. About 2 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

probes.style: local a = rawget(_G, 'CameraDistance_API'); return a and a.get('coop_style') or 'no api'
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts. 20 seconds.
CLASSIC camera on. Stand together: the camera should sit higher and further back, centred between you. 10 seconds.
steps.each_frame: if not _G['__tg_cam_a'] then _G['__tg_cam_a'] = true; local a = rawget(_G, 'CameraDistance_API'); if a then a.set('coop_style', 'classic') end end

steps.text: Walk apart (20-30 m), then come back together, a couple of times. The camera stays centred on both and zooms with the gap. 25 seconds.
Fight the air and run around each other. PLAYER 1: turn the camera with the right stick. 20 seconds.
The FOLLOW camera (the one you had): walk apart again to compare. 20 seconds.
steps.each_frame: if not _G['__tg_cam_b'] then _G['__tg_cam_b'] = true; local a = rawget(_G, 'CameraDistance_API'); if a then a.set('coop_style', 'follow') end end

steps.text: PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op.
Done. Tell Claude: which camera do you prefer? Angle, distance, too high / low? (Camera Distance settings -> Co-op camera has sliders for the classic one.)
